english.title: Designated premises supervisor knowingly allow sale of alcohol to drunk - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the designated premises supervisor for **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES AND LOCATION..), knowingly allowed the sale of alcohol on those premises to a person who was drunk
english.legislation: Contrary to section 141(1)(b), (2)(b)(ii) and (4) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

english.notes:
As from 08/04/2013 Penalty Notices for Disorder may ONLY be issued to offenders aged 18 years or over.This offence may be disposed of by the issue of a Penalty Notice for Disorder - DA16(i) The Penalty Notice for Disorder was raised from £80 to £90 as from 01/07/13.
(ii) Fingerprints, photographs and DNA samples may be taken from an individual where he/she is subject to arrest and the Penalty Notice is issued at a police station
